body.p: Long ago a human lived together with his family. Once there came robbers. Uron wandered off along the shore of the river. He made a camp. He made the camp and went for wood. He saw traces. He didn't know about the robbers, who had hid in the bushes. He noticed it and ran off. They shot the one jumping to the other side of the river [= Uren] into his feet. They killed [him]. They came to his tent and entered. An old man, Uren's father, covered his grandchild with his kettle. They brought away the child's mother, the old man and the child were left back. Only the two together, child and its grandfather, were left back. The child is growing year by year. The old man started to teach the child. Kogun and his people came every day. The old man hid the child [folded(?) it]. They didn't notice anything and went off. The child, having learned, started to go off without asking its grandfather. Having left once, it met an old man forging arrows at the shore of the river. The child started to ask the old man: "From whom was I born?" The old man told that its parents had been killed by some men. Having come home, the child started to ask its grandfather about its parents. The old man told the boy, where the robbers live. He said [that] they are camping at the high(?) shore of a river, on a steep bank. "You will see [that] in the middle of the tents a big tent is standing. In that tent their leader(?) is living with your mother." When his grandfather has told, he [= the boy] went off. Going he saw tents on the other side of the tundra, on a tussock(?). Having reached the edge of tundra, he hid his arrows(?). Having reached the tents, the boy saw men forging outside. Having come he entered the big tent and saw his mother. His heart was racing. His mother, having recognized her child, fed him, gave him tea to drink. The boy, having finished eating, looked out and saw people going by boat. One man has overtaken his relatives by far. When their leader's(?) boat had landed, he went home. Entering he saw the boy sitting at the other side [of the tent]. Having sat down at his personal place, he asked his wife: "Did you feed the guest?" The boy said: "I am not about to eat your food". Having said so he jumped out. Behind him Kogun jumped out. Having jumped out he saw the boy running on the other side of the tundra. Kogun ran off, he left(?) his relatives. The boy shot into the forehead of the running one. The boy killed Kogun, he left his [= Kogun's] people, he himself took his mother home. Having come, they had wandered off from their temporary camp. When a had year passed, he went hunting. He left the killed wild reindeer there, where he had killed it, until morning has broken. In the morning, going after the pray (?), he saw a bear on his wild reindeer. The bear, having noticed the coming one, stood on its hind legs. Having seen the human, the bear went towards him. The boy shot. He didn't make it to shoot again. The bear jumped on the human. They were fighting the whole day. The human won over the bear. Then he himself died.
